statement.text:
a) Is it true that for each word w, there is a function h : N × N → N such
that the width of w in every finite p-group of Prüfer rank r is bounded by h(p, r)?
   b) If so, can h(p, r) be made independent of p?
   An affirmative answer to a) would imply A. Jaikin-Zapirain’s result (ibid.) that
every word has finite width in each p-adic analytic pro-p group, since a pro-p group is
p-adic analytic if and only if the Prüfer ranks of all its finite quotients are uniformly
bounded.                                                                          D. Segal
